Subject: Let’s Get Another Call Scheduled

Hi Tianna,

It was so great connecting with you. I really enjoyed our conversation and would love to keep the momentum going.

I’d love to set up another call with you, this time including your husband as well as my partner, Eric Hern. I think it would be really valuable for all of us to connect together, align on everything, and explore what this could look like moving forward.

Let me know what your availability looks like over the next few days, and we’ll coordinate a time that works best for everyone.

Looking forward to it,
Bethany

Subject: Excited About What We’re Building Together

Hi Tianna,

I’ve been thinking about our conversation, and I just wanted to say how aligned it felt, not just from a business standpoint, but from an ethics and values perspective as well. That’s something we don’t take lightly, and it really stood out to me.

We would love to continue this conversation and bring your husband into the mix, along with my partner, Eric Hern, so we can all get on the same page and explore how we can build something meaningful together.

From our side, we see a really strong opportunity to integrate you and your team as our go-to buyer within our ecosystem. As we work with med spas through our growth programs, having a trusted partner to guide acquisitions or next steps creates a ton of value for everyone involved.

At the same time, we would love to position ourselves as Ezer Health’s go-to growth partner. Not only for med spas that need to scale and become viable acquisition opportunities, but also to help strengthen and grow the locations you’ve already acquired. That combination of growth plus acquisition feels like a very powerful lane to build in together.

Let me know what your availability looks like, and we’ll coordinate a time that works for everyone.

Looking forward to continuing this,
Bethany
